question: TCS Ninja / Digital (NQT) managerial and HR rounds. Reported company-knowledge questions: **Who is the current CEO of TCS** (and who was the previous one)? **Where is the head office of TCS?** **Can you name some TCS projects or three companies of the Tata group?** **What was TCS's result in the last quarter?** Other candidates were also asked to explain a latest technology and to say why they want to join TCS.
lookingFor: Genuine interest and basic homework about the company you are joining.
Awareness of what TCS does: IT services, consulting and products.
Honesty: saying you will check a number instead of guessing it.
Ability to connect the company's work to your own interests.
answer:
Company-knowledge questions test preparation, so verify every fact within a day or two of the interview; leadership and results change. Do not memorise from this write-up; check TCS's own pages (the About Us and Investors sections of tcs.com, and the latest press release).

**What to prepare**
- **Who TCS is.** Tata Consultancy Services is the IT services, consulting and business-solutions arm of the Tata group. It is part of the Tata group, with Tata Sons as the promoter.
- **Current CEO and MD.** As of my knowledge, K. Krithivasan took over in June 2023 from Rajesh Gopinathan, who was CEO from 2017. Before him N. Chandrasekaran led TCS and is now Chairman of Tata Sons. Confirm the current name on tcs.com before the interview, because it is a fast-changing fact.
- **Head office.** TCS is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Check the exact registered-office address on the company site if asked, and know your own interview city's office or campus.
- **Tata group companies** (name three you are sure of): Tata Steel, Tata Motors, Tata Power, Titan, Tata Consumer Products, Indian Hotels (Taj), Air India, Tata Sons.
- **TCS offerings and projects.** Examples: TCS BaNCS (banking and financial products), TCS iON (the digital assessment and learning platform that NQT itself runs on), TCS Ignio (AI-based IT operations), and government projects such as Passport Seva. Mention only ones you have read about.
- **Last quarter results.** Do not guess. Open the latest quarterly results page, note revenue and net profit direction (up or down on the year), and use the language "I read that the company reported ... in Q_ FY_". If you have not checked, say so and name the page you would check.

**How to answer.** Be short and factual, then connect: "I follow TCS because of its work in cloud and AI services, and I would like to build skills in X."

**Mistakes**: confident wrong numbers, outdated leadership, and listing companies that are not Tata group firms.
followUps: Why do you want to join TCS and not another IT services company?
What business units or services does TCS offer?
What do you know about the TCS Ninja, Digital and Prime profiles?
What is the latest technology news you have read about TCS?
